QUOTE: Tiers 3 and 4 are not user-settable. Tier 3 is facts the target already wrote, such as a Doxyfile's `PREDEFINED`/`ALIASES` or a generator manifest. Tier 4 is known-ecosystem signatures. Tier 5 is name-pattern heuristics, the floor.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names five precedence tiers (1 explicit, 2 declared, 3 facts, 4 ecosystem signatures, 5 heuristics) and gives the combination rule `(tier1 or tier2 or tier5) ∪ tier3 ∪ tier4`, so it is not a single override.
